diagnosticTrigger: A settle race in deferred resize ordering exposed the production projection-refresh defect.
supersedes: The initial harness-only attribution was incorrect. Ordinary public preset imports use the same defective camera/target setters.
cause: Preset view.camera.* and view.target.* setters mutate position/target without refreshing projection. updateActiveCameraProjection derives the orthographic frustum from distance-to-target, but setProjectionMode returns early for an unchanged mode and afterApplySettings does not refresh it. A camera/target batch can therefore retain the previous distance's frustum until resize. Deferred resize ordering exposed this app defect after session restoration in QA; extra frame waits alone do not repair it.

appDefect.proposedFix: After a preset batch touching any view.camera.* or view.target.* key, update controls and refresh the active projection once using the current viewport dimensions. Do not refresh per axis.
appDefect.sessionScope: Complete hydration refreshes explicitly in restoreSessionView. The confirmed session-path trigger is a subsequent preset camera batch; verify both APIs in the 0.9.x fix.

ordinaryApiVerification.cameraOnlyBatch: Reproduced stale half-height 19.428338208873594; resize corrects it to 12.426406871192833.
ordinaryApiVerification.targetOnlyBatch: Reproduced stale half-height 19.428338208873594; resize corrects it to 17.078462692276148.
ordinaryApiVerification.completeSessionHydration: Projection is correct before resize because restoreSessionView explicitly refreshes it.

ruledOut.unpinnedAnimation: Auto-rotation is false in both states; the fixture contains no trajectory or vibration. Both images remain stable across repeated rendered frames.
ruledOut.uninitializedRestoreValue: restoreSessionView initializes the frustum from the valid saved pose. Both differing frusta are finite, deterministic projections of the old/new camera distances.
ruledOut.clearedDrawingBuffer: The differing hash is a fully rendered water molecule, and the canvas size does not change.

resolution.scope: QA workaround only; the 0.9.x app defect remains open and app.js/vendor code is unchanged
resolution.verificationLimit: Passing pinned captures and the resize-order regression do not establish that ordinary preset camera/target batches refresh projection correctly.
resolution.cameraPin: Explicitly switch through perspective before applying the orthographic pose so frustum initialization never depends on a deferred resize.
resolution.structuredCapture: Include the actual rendered camera projection matrix/near/far/zoom and canvas CSS/buffer dimensions.
resolution.regression: For both resize orderings after restoring the fixture, compare full structured capture and same-browser pixel hash before and after another resize.
